City of Inglewood
  Finance Department
  (310) 412-5257

  AGENDA
  CLAIMS REVIEW COMMITTEE
  August 17, 2020

11:30 a.m. – Finance Executive Conference, 1th Floor

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
Persons wishing to address the Inglewood Claims Review Committee on any item on the agenda may do
so at this time.

  1. Approve the minutes of the August 03, 2020, meeting.

  2. Shoeteria – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for providing protective
  safety footwear to employees working in hazardous conditions.

  3. Buchalter – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for consulting services.

  4. Pinnacle Petroleum – Executive session to discuss recommend payment for the use of
  gas cards for petroleum fuel.

Public Comments Regarding Other Matters
Persons wishing to address the Claims Review Committee on any matter connected with City business not
elsewhere considered on the agenda may do so at this time.

  Adjournment.

  Distribution
  Campos, K
  Heaney, M.
  Horton, Y.
